About Us

A Quran Academy for Families Everywhere

WeFix Quran Center is an online Quran academy for Muslim families living around the world. Our mission is simple: to make good Quran teaching easy to reach, wherever you live.

Many families abroad find it hard to reach a local teacher. With us, your child learns at home, one-to-one with a teacher, at a time that fits your family's day — in the UK, USA, Canada, Europe, Australia, or anywhere else.

From a child's very first letter in Noorani Qaida to reading, Tajweed and memorising the Quran, we stay with your family at every step.

Our Teachers

Teachers Who Care About Every Lesson

In every class, the teacher listens to the student read, corrects mistakes with patience, and gives a small, clear target for the next lesson. Nothing is rushed, and no question is too small.

  • The teacher hears the student's recitation in every class
  • Mistakes are corrected kindly, on the spot
  • Parents receive updates on their child's progress
  • Revision is built into every course, not left to chance

Want to know more about our teachers? Send us a message on WhatsApp and ask us anything — we will happily tell you more before your free trial.
